item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-f8d678d88b16e115","start_unit":30,"end_unit":31,"fact_summary":"Under Lula, Brazil introduced an Observatory of Violence against Journalists in early 2023; CPJ reported that no journalist was murdered in Brazil during 2023, but perpetrators of 11 journalist killings during the index period remained at large.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.8","4B.3","4B.10","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The observatory and 2023 no-new-killing finding fit 2023; the 11 unresolved killings span the CPJ index period and are not all attributable to Lula.","ruler_attribution":"The report explicitly identifies the observatory as a measure introduced by Lula's government; unresolved prior killings reflect inherited institutional conditions.","limitations":["The source does not provide the observatory's staffing, budget, investigative outputs, or causal effect.","No-new-killing data does not establish that Lula's government caused the outcome."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0757c99b8dc5074b","start_unit":14,"end_unit":16,"fact_summary":"The National Education Council's 2023 composition included two chambers of 12 councillors each and a full council; its 2023 record lists approved opinions and resolutions on vocational education, hybrid learning, prison education, special education, teacher training, diploma recognition, university extension, psychology, architecture, and other educational standards.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.4","6B.9","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers the 2023 administrative year.","ruler_attribution":"The record concerns a federal education council exercising normative, deliberative, and advisory functions within the Ministry of Education; it does not by itself establish Lula's personal direction of each decision.","limitations":["The document reports institutional outputs but not execution rates, budget use, service outcomes, or Lula's direct role.","Approval of standards does not demonstrate implementation or impact."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0757c99b8dc5074b","start_unit":17,"end_unit":24,"fact_summary":"During 2023, the National Education Council held scheduled studies, technical meetings, evaluations, public-policy discussions, and commissions covering basic and higher education, literacy, school safety, education in prisons, special education, racial and ethnic education, quotas, teacher formation, digital education, artificial intelligence, and the National Education Plan.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.4","6B.5","6B.9","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers activities recorded throughout 2023.","ruler_attribution":"These are documented federal institutional activities during Lula's 2023 administration, but the source does not attribute individual agenda items to Lula personally.","limitations":["The source records meetings and deliberation rather than completed implementation or outcomes.","It does not establish equitable access, funding adequacy, or effectiveness of the resulting policies."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3567c1ba3a40209e","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The Lula administration reappointed the steering committee responsible for Brazil's Universalization of Telecommunications Services Fund in March 2023; the fund's stated focus included broadband connectivity, and the Ministry of Communications later announced 1.17 billion reais for connectivity projects focused on schools, favelas, and rural areas.","question_ids":["4B.6","5B.6","6B.2","6B.3","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The committee reappointment occurred in March 2023; the 1.17-billion-real disbursement announcement occurred after the report's June 2022–May 2023 coverage period, so only the announced policy direction is contemporaneous with the broader 2023 period.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the committee reappointment to Lula's administration and the later funding announcement to the Ministry of Communications.","limitations":["The source does not establish how much funding was actually disbursed during 2023 or the resulting connectivity gains.","The 1.17-billion-real announcement is explicitly after the report's stated coverage period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3567c1ba3a40209e","start_unit":10,"end_unit":12,"fact_summary":"In the first 40 days of 2023, the Ministry of Communications installed 282 Wi-Fi Brasil access points, mainly benefiting the underconnected Northeast; by April 2023, 6,950 Internet Brasil chips had been delivered, with a stated goal of 100,000 chips for public-school students by year-end.","question_ids":["5B.6","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.3","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers implementation reported in early 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the Wi-Fi Brasil activity to the Ministry of Communications and the Internet Brasil distribution to a government program operating under Lula's administration.","limitations":["The figures are implementation outputs, not evidence of sustained service quality, educational effects, or final 2023 target completion.","The chip program originated before Lula's term, so attribution is primarily to continuation and implementation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3567c1ba3a40209e","start_unit":47,"end_unit":49,"fact_summary":"During the first six months of Lula's administration, Globo received the largest share among media groups of reported public advertising funds; Globo's website received 394,500 reais from a total of 54.4 million reais received by the group, while Meta, TikTok, and Google together received about 4 percent of the funds among the 15 largest recipients.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","5B.5","7B.3","7B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly covers the first six months of Lula's administration in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source reports public advertising allocations by Lula's administration's communications apparatus.","limitations":["The figures do not establish favoritism, unlawful influence, or whether allocations followed transparent criteria.","The source does not provide the complete distribution methodology or comparison with prior administrations."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3567c1ba3a40209e","start_unit":55,"end_unit":56,"fact_summary":"In February 2023, Brazil's Federal Comptroller General issued a technical opinion that the General Data Protection Law does not override the Access to Information Law and indicated that additional harmonizing guidance was expected.","question_ids":["4B.4","4B.6","5B.7","6B.5","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers a federal institutional clarification in February 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The opinion was issued by the Federal Comptroller General during Lula's administration; the source does not state that Lula personally ordered it.","limitations":["The document does not show subsequent compliance, data-release outcomes, or whether the guidance was fully implemented.","The opinion addressed an inherited legal-administrative conflict."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3567c1ba3a40209e","start_unit":71,"end_unit":74,"fact_summary":"In March 2023, reporting identified that Brazil's intelligence agency had used the First Mile software under the Bolsonaro administration to track mobile-phone locations; in June 2023, a Lula-administration decree changed the composition of the Central Data Governance Committee by removing three executive-branch representatives.","question_ids":["4B.4","4B.9","7B.6","7B.7","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The surveillance conduct is inherited from before Lula's period; the committee change occurred in June 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the committee change to Lula's administration but does not establish that Lula personally initiated or evaluated the inherited surveillance program.","limitations":["The document does not establish whether the June decree reduced unlawful surveillance or changed operational access to data.","The First Mile reporting concerns the predecessor administration and is not evidence of Lula's conduct."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-ef4ba5912aebb3fd","SRC-f8ab00588ca74e22","SRC-cf5ca794ada9ab83","SRC-4cd6c76eaee1a004","SRC-ab64c22f4c77fe89","SRC-2acff854a5bfcd04","SRC-451bee089bc8afc1","SRC-a558e88d4ea803fd"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents primarily describe Bolsonaro-era conditions, historical Lula administrations, general perceptions of Brazil, bibliographic metadata, or inaccessible book content rather than Lula's 2023–2023 actions.","No supplied document provides material evidence about Lula's nuclear-risk, war, corruption, macroeconomic, or personal-integrity conduct specifically during 2023."]}
